title: Correlated initialization of deep residual networks
summary: We study the large-depth behavior of residual networks whose weights are correlated across layers at initialization. Our results confirm and extend a conjecture of Marion et al. [2025], according to which correlated initializations should interpolate continuously between the Brownian stochastic differential equation arising from independent initialization and the ordinary differential equation arising from perfectly correlated initialization.
